//! Typed state cells implemented in Terlan over VM process primitives.

module std.vm.Agent.

pub type Agent[T] =
    {Atom["agent"], process: std.vm.Process[AgentCommand[T]], placeholder: T}.

pub type AgentCommand[T] =
    {Atom["agent_command"], kind: AgentCommandKind, request_id: Int, reply_to: std.vm.Process[AgentReply[T]], value: T}.

pub type AgentCommandKind =
    AgentInit
  | AgentGet
  | AgentUpdate
  | AgentGetAndUpdate
  | AgentStop.

pub type AgentCommandTag =
    Atom["agent_command"].

pub type AgentGet =
    Atom["agent_get"].

pub type AgentGetAndUpdate =
    Atom["agent_get_and_update"].

pub type AgentInit =
    Atom["agent_init"].

pub type AgentReply[T] =
    {Atom["agent_reply"], request_id: Int, value: T}.

pub type AgentStop =
    Atom["agent_stop"].

pub type AgentTag =
    Atom["agent"].

pub type AgentUpdate =
    Atom["agent_update"].

pub await_reply[T](request_id: Int, witness: T): T.

pub cast[T](agent: Agent[T], value: T): Unit.

pub get[T](agent: Agent[T], request_id: Int): T.

pub get_and_update[T](agent: Agent[T], request_id: Int, value: T): T.

pub make_agent[T](process: std.vm.Process[AgentCommand[T]], initial: T): Agent[T].

pub request_get[T](agent: Agent[T], request_id: Int, reply_to: std.vm.Process[AgentReply[T]]): Unit.

pub send_reply[T](reply_to: std.vm.Process[AgentReply[T]], request_id: Int, value: T): Unit.

pub serve[T](witness: T): Unit.

pub serve_state[T](state: T): Unit.

pub start[T](process: std.vm.Process[AgentCommand[T]], initial: T): Agent[T].

pub stop[T](agent: Agent[T], request_id: Int): Unit.

pub update[T](agent: Agent[T], value: T): Unit.

//! One-shot tasks implemented in Terlan over VM process primitives.

module std.vm.Task.

pub type Task[T] =
    {Atom["task"], process: std.vm.Process[TaskCommand[T]], witness: T}.

pub type TaskAwait =
    Atom["task_await"].

pub type TaskCancel =
    Atom["task_cancel"].

pub type TaskCommand[T] =
    {Atom["task_command"], kind: TaskCommandKind, request_id: Int, reply_to: std.vm.Process[TaskReply[T]], witness: T}.

pub type TaskCommandKind =
    TaskAwait
  | TaskCancel.

pub type TaskCommandTag =
    Atom["task_command"].

pub type TaskReply[T] =
    {Atom["task_reply"], request_id: Int, value: T}.

pub type TaskReplyTag =
    Atom["task_reply"].

pub type TaskTag =
    Atom["task"].

pub await_reply[T](request_id: Int, witness: T): T.

/// Requests cooperative task shutdown without host-runtime task machinery.

pub cancel[T](task: Task[T]): Unit.

pub make_task[T](process: std.vm.Process[TaskCommand[T]], witness: T): Task[T].

/// Thin policy wrapper for VM-owned failure monitoring.

pub monitor[T](task: Task[T]): Unit.

/// Thin policy wrapper for VM-owned symmetric links.

pub relate_peer[T](task: Task[T]): Unit.

/// Waits for a correlated task value and discards stale replies.

pub result[T](task: Task[T], request_id: Int): T.

/// Publishes a completed value until the owner reads or cancels the task.

pub serve[T](value: T): Unit.

/// Builds a typed task handle for a statically spawned task entry.

pub start[T](process: std.vm.Process[TaskCommand[T]], witness: T): Task[T].
